about: Key moments for chapter 17, seeded by the project as a starting point.

jobs.prompt: Wide establishing shot on a calm morning. A man in plain clothes, seen from behind, walks along a straight footpath lined on both sides by tall leafy trees whose branches meet overhead. At the end of the path rises a large circular parliament building of pale grey stone, round and low with many tall windows and a shallow dome, half framed by greenery. Dappled sunlight falls across the path, moss and fallen leaves line its edges, and a small round green-glowing panel sits beside a side door of the building in the distance.

Medium-wide interior of a small, warm side office with wood paneling, a stone wall, a low table and two chairs, and a tall window onto green trees. The man from reference image 1, in a long formal parliament robe, sits laughing warmly. Opposite him, the man from reference image 2 sits staring in surprise. A small sleek serving robot on wheels has just glided into the room between them, its little screen showing soft abstract colored shapes. Soft afternoon daylight.

Medium shot in a wood-paneled office with a tall window onto green trees. A friendly middle-aged visitor wearing a loose dark purple robe with its hood pushed back and his face uncovered holds out a hand device toward the man from reference image 1, who leans forward with curious attention. The device's screen glows with a simple branching diagram of colored circles joined by thin lines, like a tree of nodes, with no labels at all. Warm afternoon daylight.

Warm evening interior of a cozy stone family home with wooden beams and a big window onto dark trees. A family sits around a dinner table with open food boxes and plates. In the center, the person from reference image 1 sits up proudly, beaming while announcing exciting news, one hand raised mid-gesture. Beside them, the young man from reference image 2 smiles quietly. Other family members around the table are seen from behind or in soft shadow, listening. One chair sits empty. Soft lamplight.
